task:
Write Python 3 function solve(rows). Before the main rule, perform this audit scan in ORIGINAL zero-based order. For an integer row its weight is that integer. For a log-string row its weight is the signed integer between pipes. For a list row its weight is the sum of integer fields excluding booleans plus the lengths of all string fields. Start state at 5. Keep a row if (state + weight + original_index) modulo 7 is not 4, or if it is the last original row. After deciding, update state for EVERY row, including omitted rows: reset to 5 if its weight is zero; otherwise set state to (5*state + weight) modulo 7. Finally rotate the kept list LEFT by final_state modulo kept_length; empty stays empty. Then apply the following main rule: Rows [group,score,timestamp,name]. Choose highest score in each group, then EARLIEST timestamp, then lexicographically GREATEST name. Return [group,name] sorted by group. Duplicates allowed.
Return the requested value, without printing. Inputs follow the types specified. Do not mutate the input. Standard library is allowed.
